```{r Projection Calculation, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Sets up table inputs
additional_flow <- reactiveVal(
  data.frame(
    Value = c("Additional Inflow to Powell (MAF)", 1, .66),
    Duration = c("Duration (months)", 12, 6)
  )
)

release <- reactiveVal(
  data.frame(
    Value = c("Annual Release from Powell (MAF/yr)", 6),
    Duration = c("Duration (months)", 24)
  )
)

output$table_af <- renderRHandsontable({
    rhandsontable(additional_flow())
  })

output$table_release <- renderRHandsontable({
  rhandsontable(release())
})

observeEvent(input$table_af, {
    additional_flow(hot_to_r(input$table_af))
  })

observeEvent(input$table_release, {
    release(hot_to_r(input$table_release))
})

# Passes inputs through projection function
projection <- reactive({
  ProjectPowell(
    Inflow = "CRMMS",
    Release = input$Release,
    Add_Release = input$Additional_Release,
    Add_Time = input$Add_Time,
    Duration = 36,
    Storage_Data = hydrodata
  )
})

# plots projection
output$projectionplot <- renderPlot({
  fplotprojection(projection())
})
annual_table <- reactive({ fAnnualValues(projection(), "inflow") })

output$annualTable <- renderTable({
  annual_table()
}, digits = 1)
  



```
```{r output, results = "show"}
plotOutput("projectionplot")
tableOutput("annualTable")

```
